title: Databricks SQL version 2026.32 is now available in Preview
body:
Databricks SQL version 2026.32 is now available in the **Preview** channel. Review the following section to learn about new features and improvements.

#### Validate VARIANT values with `is_valid_variant`

The `is_valid_variant` function returns `true` when its input is a well-formed `VARIANT` value and `false` otherwise. Use it to validate variant data before downstream processing. See [Query variant data](/aws/en/semi-structured/variant).

#### `INSERT INTO ... REPLACE` for upsert-style writes

`INSERT INTO` now supports `REPLACE USING (<columns>)` and `REPLACE ON <condition>` clauses, which replace existing rows that match on the specified columns or condition. See [`INSERT`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-dml-insert-into).

#### Scalar UDFs as table-valued function arguments

You can now pass scalar user-defined functions (UDFs) as arguments to table-valued functions. See [Table-valued function (TVF) invocation](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-syntax-qry-select-tvf).
